name: fatestone-of-heaven-enter-destroy-cheap-object
notes: Fatestone of Heaven (al6pqkmgmz, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["al6pqkmgmz:0"] calls Custom/CardLogic.php's FatestoneOfHeavenEnter(), which builds an MZCHOOSE of non-champion objects with memory cost 0-1 or reserve cost 0-5; customDQHandlers["FatestoneOfHeavenDestroy"] resolves it): "On Enter: Destroy target non-champion object with memory cost 1 or less, or reserve cost 5 or less." Fatestone of Heaven is LUXEM, so the champion's Subcards are patched with Zander, Blinding Steel's lineage for element access. Its own printed reserve cost (3) makes it a legal target of its own ability, so the MZCHOOSE offers both itself and the seeded opponent's Fluffy Shopkeep (reserve 3); the opponent's ally is chosen. Verified live: Fluffy Shopkeep moves to the opponent's graveyard. Break/restore verified: commenting out the AllyDestroyed() call for the ALLY branch makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again. Note: FatestoneOfHeavenDestroy's non-ALLY/TOKEN branch does a raw OnLeaveField()+MZMove() instead of AllyDestroyed(), the same bypass pattern flagged as a bug for other cards in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php's header comment -- not fixed here since choosing an ALLY target sidesteps it, but worth checking if this card is ever used to destroy an ITEM/WEAPON target.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Destroy target non-champion object with memory cost 1 or less, or reserve cost 5 or less.
